title: Bounded signed-state observation in the idle-renewal fixture

observed_failure.exception: carr_library.security._files.BusyError: Another trusted-client operation is running.
boundary: wait_until(lambda: not worker.running) returned while the periodic host remained enabled at interval .02.
The Windows msvcrt.LK_NBLCK contention was converted to the unchanged BusyError.

decoded_job_log.source: GitHub workflow job logs API decoded response; the complete raw trace was reviewed.

observed_failure.actual_module_verdict: FAIL: tests/security/test_idle_renewal.py: junit_passed=3, failed=1, skipped=0, pytest_exit=1

source_contract.classification: Fixture observation race; no application-source change.
rationale: RefreshWorker.running is a synchronized observation of _checking and the current renewal thread, not a reservation against a later IdleRenewalHost tick.
The real periodic host calls worker.tick() again; tick reads the current signed entitlement before its due-time decision.
The nonblocking trust lock correctly refuses overlapping readers/publication operations. Its production behavior remains unchanged.

changes: Observe the actual signed sequence inside the existing finite two-second wait after checking worker.running.
Retry only BusyError raised by the test observation; other trust/signature/store failures still propagate.
Keep the live periodic host enabled throughout both automatic renewals and retain the second renewal without another UI/idle action.
Require exactly one first renewal and exactly two total renewals.
After the existing close and thread-settlement assertions, require the actual stored signed sequence to remain 3.
retained_assertions: Disabled by default despite an idle signal.
An explicitly enabled host starts once and does not renew during active-user state.
The first and periodic second renewals use the actual worker/provider thread and signed entitlement store.
Exact configured profile and credential-reference bindings.
The host thread and worker are settled after close.
The other three module cases remain byte-for-byte unchanged: blocked-vault late-launch refusal, withdrawn capability/no transport, and timed-out reply/no protected-state advance.

source_only: All four top-level test identities are unchanged.
Reversing only the documented import/helper/two observation/final-state changes reproduces the exact old test file.
All three other test bodies are byte-for-byte retained.
The complete current refresh/store/lock owner and actual Windows failure trace were read.
